title.narrative: Start Fund 911 Somalia Multi-Sectoral Integrated Hum Response to Displacement

description.narrative: This project aims to deliver life -saving humanitarian assistance to the most vulnerable displaced populations in targeted 6 unserved/underserved locations through cash -based assistance, Water Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) interventions, and protection services. The proposed assistance is based on nationally agreed standards and guidelines at WASH and Protection Cluster and Cash Working Group level. Key activities include: - Multipurpose cash to 400 households for two months in one go following cash working group's recommended transfer value of 130 USD/Household/month. - Emergency water supply for 6000 people for 30 days following Sphere Standards and WASH Cluster guidelines and using cash/voucher -based modality in consultation with private sector, authorities and communities. - Hygiene kits distribution to 1,000 households using standard household hygiene kit content and quality recommended by WASH Cluster based on locally adopted items and specification guided by Sphere Standards. - Hygiene promotion in targeted 6 locations using public health risk reduction approach by employing range of media – including community volunteers, community level committees, opinion leaders, information, education and communication material and mass media to reach estimated 10,000 individuals – including at high -risk population like families with children under five, elderly, people with chronical illnesses, pregnant and breastfeeding women and adolescents. - 50 cases mainly targeting survivors of gender -based violence (GBV) and individuals facing immediate protection risks will be assisted through cash for protection modality. - Dissemination of lifesaving protection messages on GBV, child protection, and rights awareness in targeted 6 locations – including directly engaging community volunteers for targeted risk communication and community engagement.
